mission: Author the Codex WIRING CONTRACT: .squad/SQ-058/wiring-rules.md — the exact mechanical rules the Codex agent must follow when generating + wiring ~40 images. Verify every rule against the actual codebase (re-derive, don't assume).
context:
The handoff report tells Codex WHAT to make; your contract tells it HOW to wire. Derive from the live codebase:
1. SHORTCODE CHOICE: {{< visual >}} vs legacy {{< image >}} — which is canonical now (count usage across content/), exact param order/optional params (src/alt/caption/wide), when wide= applies.
2. FILE CONVENTIONS: dir static/images/articles/<slug>/, kebab-case names, .webp, hero naming (_hero_v2), og-image handling (frontmatter image: doubles as og?), sizing guidance (width/height attrs — what do existing wirings pass?).
3. ALT-TEXT RULES: mine 20+ existing {{< visual >}} wirings for the alt-text voice (honest descriptive, 'Illustrative...' prefix for product images?) — codify the pattern with 5 examples.
4. FRONTMATTER: when may a plan change image:/hero_below_answer:? (only REPLACE-verdict heroes).
5. AFFILIATE IMAGES: product-box auto-renders from data/product_images.yaml — Codex must NOT touch that yaml unless adding a NEW ASIN (not in scope); product-figure rule (any recommended-product image must be affiliate-wired).
6. VERIFICATION STEPS Codex must run after wiring: hugo build, rendered-img grep (every src resolves, count per page 3-7), alt presence, lazy-loading, no CLS (width/height present), file sizes (<150KB guideline — check what current assets weigh, quote the real distribution).
7. RECONCILE: yaml 12 ASINs vs 9 distinct files (shared smart-plug reuse) — CONFIRM/REFUTE the coverage claim.
8. WIRING PRECEDENT: quote 3 exemplary existing wirings verbatim (one standard, one wide, one captioned).
known_facts: Commander pre-verified: 12/12 yaml entries have on-disk files.
The 10 target pages' content was edited today (SQ-057) — plans will reference its section headings; Codex must place after the exact heading, before the named following block.
constraints: Every rule carries evidence (counts, quoted lines, file paths).
success_criteria: wiring-rules.md written with all 8 sections evidence-backed
